slides.title: Things that finally ended my 'rewash it 3 times' laundry era
A basket in every room that makes laundry
slides.body: Bedroom, bathroom, kids' rooms. If the hamper is more than 3 steps away, the floor becomes the hamper.

slides.title: Laundry sorter with labeled bags
slides.body: Sort as you toss, not on laundry day. One full bag = one load. No decisions needed later.

slides.title: Magnetic 'washer is full' sign
slides.body: Flip it when you start a load. It sits on the machine and nags you so your brain doesn't have to.

slides.title: A bin for each person, not a folding pile
slides.body: Clean laundry goes into their bin. Folding is optional. The mountain on the couch disappears.

slides.title: Wall hooks by the dresser
slides.body: For jeans and 'worn once' clothes. They stop landing on the chair when they have a hook.

slides.title: Folding is a side quest. Clean and out of the washer is the main quest.
